sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Broadband burst sits in a regular ~0.25 s pulse visible across the whole window (6.4, 6.65, 6.85, 7.3 s); could be a swoosh layered on the music beat or the beat itself.

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Low-frequency onset matching the periodic beat grid; coincides with 'Motion' appearing but looks like a music hit, not a designed SFX.

pattern.description: Collage of photo tiles and a UI card drifts in opposing directions (photos slide down/left, card rises from bottom-left) while the two-word title 'Figma Motion' pops in centre, first white then switching to brand orange.
pattern.why_premium: Layers move at different speeds and directions, giving depth to a flat collage; the title lands in the calm centre of the moving field, and the white-to-orange colour snap makes the brand name read as a beat rather than a fade.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.fromTo(['.tile-photo','.tile-leaf'], {y:-260}, {y:0, duration:0.6, ease:'power3.out', stagger:0.04}); gsap.fromTo('.card-panel', {y:200}, {y:0, duration:0.6, ease:'power3.out'}, '<'); title: gsap.set('.w-figma',{autoAlpha:1, color:'#fff'}, 0.25); gsap.set('.w-motion',{autoAlpha:1, color:'#fff'}, 0.5); gsap.to(['.w-figma','.w-motion'], {color:'#ff7237', duration:0.08, ease:'none'}, 0.58).
build_hint.remotion: Per layer translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:120, mass:1}}), [0,1], [fromY,0]) with opposing fromY for photos (negative) and card (positive); words visible from frames 3 and 6 with colour switched to orange at frame 7 (hard cut, no interpolation).

notes: camera.move reports tilt_up, but tiles move in opposing directions (photos down, card up), so this reads as layered content motion rather than a single camera move. Title colour change white->orange is a hard switch between f88 and f89.
